issues.title: Switch to one planning-force per force
issues.body:
For the clustered icons we show the cluster icon shaded in a color.

Currently the clusters are green/yellow/amber depending upon the cluster size.

Instead, we should to per-force clusters, and shade the clusters according to the force color.

Note: we should still not cluster `selected` assets.

Note 2: @lilitkarapetyan has mastered over-riding the cluster function here:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2310/files#diff-0cd02d4e329c4ead1df64feffa5033f1d7088832d26603502eb94f3da176f71fR20

I guess we have these requirements:
- component receives:
    - asset-rows for this view
    - selected assets
    - filtered assets (may be contents of filtered or current assets lists)
- if subject force === player force or player is umpire then
    - collate all assets
    - also render range-rings (phase 2)
    - do not cluster selected assets
- else
    - decide perception of asset
    - render asset according to perception 
    - do not cluster selected assets
